versions.changelog:
Initial release of the alv-codebase-documenter skill.

- Provides structured templates and best practices for writing READMEs, architecture documentation, code comments, and API docs.
- Includes beginner-friendly principles and step-by-step documentation workflows.
- Offers concrete templates for README, architecture, and API documentation in assets/templates/.
- Details when and how to use each documentation type.
- Outlines best practices for clear, accessible project documentation.
